resources.string: Sign in to see the leaderboard
The leaderboard compares the distance commas record, between CommaView beta members who choose to join. Sign in with your invited CommaView account to see it and join.
The leaderboard is for beta members
You\'re on the list. Once your invite is ready, you can join the leaderboard from here.
The leaderboard needs a current access pass. Connect %1$s to the internet (a comma\'s hotspot doesn\'t count) and renew it, or sign in again.
See where your commas rank this week.
Compare comma-recorded distance with other members. Opt in with a public name.
Opt in to see where your commas rank.
Nobody has distance this week yet. Opt in to be first on the board.
Last week\'s podium. Opt in to take them on.

Members see your public name, your rank, and for each comma you add: its public name, which comma it is (comma four, comma 3X or comma 3) and the distance it recorded this week, last week and all time since it joined. The board also shows each comma\'s all-time distance as comma.ai has it, which the comma fetches from comma.ai itself. Only signed-in CommaView beta members can see the board.
Each comma you add signs its daily totals with a key of its own: per UTC day, the distance, the driving time and the number of drives. %1$s passes them on. Driving time and drives stay private.
Never sent: positions, routes, addresses, drive start and end times, video, your car or its VIN, and your comma\'s dongle ID.
Leave whenever you like, in the app: Leaderboard › Your profile › Leave the leaderboard. Leaving deletes your name, your commas\' names and keys, and every day total.
